svg.title: Contemporary 2BHK Residence
svg.desc: "Contemporary 2BHK Residence" — a 8-room floor plan, 97 m² total: Entrance Foyer (5 m²), Living Room (22 m²), Dining Space (16 m²), Kitchen (12 m²), Master Bedroom (16 m²), Master Ensuite (5 m²), Second Bedroom (16 m²), Common Bathroom (5 m²); 1 door, 2 windows, entrance via d_d_entry.
